messages.subject: Executive Candidate | Strategic Partnerships, Country Operations & External Affairs | Dubai/GCC
messages.body:
Dear Starnest Leadership Team,

I am reaching out through your published leadership trust channel because the careers@starnest.ai address returned as undeliverable. I would appreciate your help routing my profile to the appropriate hiring contact.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated banking and commercial operations. My leadership scope spans ESG and social responsibility, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination, executive communications and cross-functional operating delivery.

I hold an MBA and BSc in Business Administration and am internationally mobile with a 30-day notice period. I am particularly interested in senior opportunities aligned with strategic partnerships, sovereign and institutional engagement, country operations, external affairs and executive coordination, including relevant Dubai and GCC mandates.

Your current Strategic Partnerships - Sovereign, Strategic Partnerships - Fintech and Chief of Staff to CEO mandates are especially relevant to the institutional, stakeholder and cross-functional dimensions of my background. I am not presenting myself as a technical AI specialist. My value lies in senior external affairs, institutional relations, partnerships, country execution and executive coordination.

I have attached my executive CV for review. I would welcome a confidential discussion or referral to the appropriate hiring team.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
